claims: Artemis II is scheduled to launch on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
Artemis II launch will take place from Launch Pad 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
A two-hour launch window is available for Artemis II.
Artemis II has additional launch opportunities running through April 6, 2026.
Live coverage of Artemis II is available on NASA's YouTube channel starting 7:45 a.m. EDT.
Live coverage of Artemis II is available on NASA+ starting 12:50 p.m. EDT.
As of March 31, 2026, there is an 80% chance of favorable weather for the Artemis II launch.
Artemis II will send four astronauts on a 10-day trip around the Moon.
Artemis II marks the first crewed mission to return to lunar vicinity since 1972
